coverage.subtopic: Loss of inhibitory myenteric neurons and failure of lower esophageal sphincter relaxation
coverage.learning_objective: Achalasia results from loss of inhibitory nitric oxide/VIP myenteric neurons, causing absent distal peristalsis and impaired lower esophageal sphincter relaxation.

coverage.subtopic: CFTR-dependent ductal bicarbonate and water secretion
coverage.learning_objective: CFTR loss in pancreatic duct epithelium reduces bicarbonate-rich fluid secretion, leading to acidic viscous secretions, duct obstruction, and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency.

coverage.subtopic: Portal-systemic collateral formation at the distal esophagus
coverage.learning_objective: Esophageal varices arise where the portal left gastric vein communicates with systemic esophageal veins draining to the azygos system.

coverage.subtopic: Colonic secretion after loss of apical sodium-dependent bile acid transport
coverage.learning_objective: Terminal ileal disease or resection prevents bile acid reclamation; bile acids entering the colon stimulate secretion and motility, causing watery diarrhea.

coverage.subtopic: Different decussation levels of corticospinal, dorsal-column, and spinothalamic pathways
coverage.learning_objective: A spinal hemisection causes ipsilateral corticospinal and dorsal-column deficits but contralateral pain-temperature loss because spinothalamic fibers cross near their level of entry.

coverage.subtopic: Loss of nigrostriatal dopamine and increased globus pallidus internus output
coverage.learning_objective: Loss of substantia nigra pars compacta dopamine reduces direct-pathway activity and increases indirect-pathway activity, raising GPi inhibition of the thalamus and suppressing movement.

coverage.subtopic: Reduced postsynaptic safety factor and decrement during repetitive stimulation
coverage.learning_objective: Myasthenia gravis reduces functional postsynaptic acetylcholine receptors and the end-plate safety factor, causing failure of some muscle fibers and a decremental response during repetitive stimulation.

coverage.subtopic: Medial longitudinal fasciculus connection between abducens interneurons and contralateral medial rectus nucleus
coverage.learning_objective: Internuclear ophthalmoplegia localizes to the medial longitudinal fasciculus ipsilateral to the eye with impaired adduction; convergence may remain intact.
